component: IMAP progress strings and synchronous proxies

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned port changes status-name IDL/C++/proxy arguments together and makes bundle/name lookup failures return errors instead of fabricated String Name text. The folder caller separately falls back when its fresh progress string stays empty. Proxy string references are retained references; the inspected dispatch runs directly on main or waits for completion, so a managed signature is not proof of a deep copy. Original callers construct nsCString; later accepted callers use nsDependentCString. Preserve that phase boundary and the remaining local raw-string conversion. The source does not prove the reported strlen crash was cured, and no crash or native run was performed.
title: The IMAP status-string port changes proxy arguments and lookup failure behavior together
